proposed_widenings.name: passive ClassFeatureMechanics family
proposed_widenings.justification: Feral Instinct is always-on with no activation cost, no use-count resource, and no rest reset. The only existing ClassFeatureMechanics family is 'activation', which requires all three header fields (activationCost, resource, resetCadence). A 'passive' family is needed for permanent class-feature riders.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Your instincts are so honed that you have Advantage on Initiative rolls.

proposed_widenings.name: "initiative" in RollKind
proposed_widenings.justification: RollKind is currently 'attack_roll' | 'saving_throw'. Initiative is a Dexterity check used at combat start — neither an attack roll nor a saving throw. Encoding advantage on initiative requires extending RollKind (or a parallel InitiativeKind) to represent this distinct roll category.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you have Advantage on Initiative rolls

notes: Two independent gaps block encoding. Primary: no 'passive' family in ClassFeatureMechanics — the activation family's header is structurally incompatible with an always-on feature. Secondary: even with a passive family, 'modify_roll_advantage on initiative' cannot be encoded because 'initiative' is absent from RollKind. The v4 atom modify_roll_advantage exists and would otherwise serve the effect, and initiative_window exists in v4 as well.
